paired.note: Epochs are correlated; these are descriptive statistics, not independent replicates.

decision.direction5_v1: No stable paired Dev IoU gain; best is a small development gain, below frozen ANN.
decision.next_recommended: Retain epoch88 and both best checkpoints; next prioritize a separate direction2 channel/group conversion calibration, initially without training or AC regularization.
decision.alternative_if_direction5_revisited: Use a new version for Main-only weight/margin or HD-aware selection; this fixed teacher-disagreement weight2 experiment does not rule out all hard-example methods.

limitations: One seed; correlated epochs and only two high-density Dev sequences.
Main threshold choices are validated on Dev; Main recall matching does not guarantee Dev matching.
Best-epoch checkpoints were selected on the repeatedly observed development set; not a final test result.
AC is an inference-equivalent count. Dense GPU execution, scalar/state costs and energy remain separate.
PyTorch allocator peaks are not whole-GPU VRAM usage; no new whole-device measurement.
